goal: Implement a bounded LRU cache with O(1) get/put and eviction on overflow.

steps.description: Implement LruCache::new, len, is_empty, get, and the insert-or-update path of put (without eviction yet)
invariants: get returns a copy of the value and reports None for missing keys
put inserts new keys and updates existing keys without growing len on update
len and is_empty reflect the current entry count

steps.description: Implement eviction of the least recently used entry when put would exceed capacity
invariants: put evicts the least recently used entry (recency refreshed by both get and put)
eviction respects access order, not insertion order
